text:
Hands at the height of the air,

two or three centimeters from emptiness,

nothing precise will be looked at:

the dust cloud passing,

the unexpected procession of feathers

plucked from flight,

the silly little pink cloud

that no longer is,

the close-your-eyes and open-them

in the brief opacity

of a light that cannot be seen,

and the dream, rubber feet,

and blue and brilliant,

the stars,

laughing,

eyelid upon eyelid,

lip against lip,

skin lingering over another

wounded and gleaming,

bonfires,

that is what we will do alone.

translation.title: Love Game
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the touch choreography and the surreal list leading into solitary bonfires.
